description: This file contains unit tests for the PersonAttribute class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing methods like toString(), equalsContent(), getHydratedObject(), and voidAttribute(). It extends the BaseContextSensitiveTest class and uses JUnit 5 assertions and annotations.

classes.name: PersonAttributeTest
classes.description: Test class for PersonAttribute methods, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for database context setup and using JUnit Jupiter for testing.

methods.name: toString_shouldReturnToStringOfHydratedValue
methods.description: Tests that the toString() method of PersonAttribute returns the expected value based on hydrated object.

methods.name: equalsContent_shouldReturnTrueIfAttributeTypeValueAndVoidStatusAreTheSame
methods.description: Verifies that equalsContent compares PersonAttributes correctly when type, value, and void status are the same.

methods.name: getHydratedObject_shouldLoadClassInFormatProperty
methods.description: Checks that getHydratedObject() loads a Concept object when the format property is 'org.openmrs.Concept'.

methods.name: getHydratedObject_shouldLoadUserClassInFormatProperty
methods.description: Ensures getHydratedObject() loads a User object when the format is 'org.openmrs.User'.

methods.name: getHydratedObject_shouldStillLoadClassInFormatPropertyIfNotAttributable
methods.description: Tests that getHydratedObject() correctly returns a String when the format is 'java.lang.String'.

methods.name: voidAttribute_shouldSetVoidedBitToTrue
methods.description: Confirms that calling voidAttribute() sets the voided flag to true.
